parameters.query:
SELECT e.account,
  jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type','engagement','signal',e.event_type,'occurred_at',e.occurred_at,'value',e.value) ORDER BY e.occurred_at) AS signals,
  (SELECT raw_payload FROM pipeline_runs p WHERE p.company = e.account ORDER BY p.run_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS raw_payload,
  (SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key='when_engine_url') AS when_engine_url
FROM engagement_events e
WHERE e.forwarded = false AND e.account IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.account;
UPDATE engagement_events SET forwarded = true WHERE forwarded = false AND account IS NOT NULL;
